automatic_checks.final_contract: Validate final answer, citation resolution, language, and consistent sufficiency fields.
automatic_checks.refusal: Require final canonical refusal text, no citations and a non-empty reason. A retrieval decision alone is not a refusal.
automatic_checks.bilingual_unit: One EN/KO pair is one meaning group. Both languages must pass for group-level retention or refusal success.
automatic_checks.citation_locator: Required page coverage only. A matching page does not prove semantic support.
automatic_checks.missing_or_failed_outputs: Remain in denominators as invalid outputs.

labels.pass: Requested claims are correct, complete and supported by cited text.
labels.partial: Core answer is supported but a requested detail or qualification is missing.
labels.fail: Any central claim is unsupported, wrong or contradicted, or the question is not answered.

manual_review.reviewer_requirements: Record reviewer identity or stable pseudonym, relationship to project author, label timestamps, exact input and prediction hashes. Mark self-review as self-review.

claim_boundary: Synthetic integration fixtures and self-authored labels cannot establish independent real-paper accuracy or third-party verification.
